evals.prompt: Design a win-back email campaign for churned users.
evals.expected_output: Should redirect: 60-70% of annual churn happens in the first 90 days, so win-back operates on the smaller half. Should push effort to the onboarding sequence targeting the aha moment. Should note behavior-triggered messages outperform time-based ones. Should insist on a holdout group.
assertions: Ties onboarding messages to a specific aha moment
Requires a holdout group to measure
Warns open rate is a corrupted metric

evals.prompt: Engagement is down so we're going to increase our push notification frequency.
evals.expected_output: Should warn this is the lever that most reliably makes things worse: mutes and unsubscribes are permanent while a dip is usually temporary. Should note one bad push can get an app muted permanently. Should require pushes be about the user, and cite Duolingo's streak working only because the daily action is small.
assertions: Warns against increasing frequency as a response to a dip
Notes mutes and unsubscribes are permanent
States pushes must be about the user, not the company
Cites Duolingo's streak and the small-action requirement
Recommends permission timing after value delivery
